title: What time is it?
subtitle: いまなんじですか
review: Written by Claude. The Japanese, the romaji and the recordings have not been checked by a Japanese speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: Two friends are going to the cinema. Listen for the two times.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

lines.romaji: E, mō kuji han desu ka.
lines.kana: え、もうくじはんですか。

lines.romaji: Hai. Eiga wa nanji kara desu ka.
lines.kana: はい。えいがはなんじからですか。

tr.en: Yes. What time does the film start?

lines.say: はい。映画は何時からですか。

lines.kana: じゃあ、いそぎましょう。

questions.why: Kuji han desu = It's half past nine.
Eiga wa... jūji kara desu = The film starts at ten.

questions.q: What do they decide to do?

notes: Ima nanji desu ka = What time is it now?
kuji = nine o'clock. jūji = ten o'clock. han = half past.
